business_problem: SIGNAL IDUNA needed to spread AI safely across a large insurance workforce, make a century of internal policy knowledge searchable, and let teams build their own agents without creating a fragmented, insecure shadow-AI environment.
solution_summary: SIGNAL IDUNA rolled out Gemini Enterprise across its workforce and used Google Cloud to turn internal insurance knowledge into a searchable, agentic asset. Employees and sales partners access the Gemini Enterprise app through an internally branded environment, while the company’s Co SI Health knowledge agent uses Document AI to extract and structure policy content and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform plus Gemini models to orchestrate reasoning across thousands of documents and more than 600 tariffs. The result is a centralized system that can return the right knowledge in under 20 seconds, while also letting employees build their own custom agents for daily work. Because the platform is company-wide and security is handled as part of Gemini Enterprise, SIGNAL IDUNA could scale adoption rapidly instead of limiting AI to small pilots. The same foundation is now positioned to support future customer-facing self-service experiences on top of the internal rollout.

business_outcome: SIGNAL IDUNA achieved rapid enterprise AI adoption, made complex policy knowledge broadly accessible, and created a secure foundation for both internal and future customer-facing insurance agents.
